reached_sql:
WITH 
ws_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ws_web_page_sk, ws_item_sk, ws_order_number, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_quantity, ws_sales_price, ws_net_profit
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
    AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
),
wr_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wr_item_sk, wr_order_number, wr_refunded_cdemo_sk, wr_returning_cdemo_sk, wr_refunded_addr_sk, wr_reason_sk, wr_refunded_cash, wr_fee
  FROM web_returns
),
wp_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wp_web_page_sk
  FROM web_page
),
d_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
),
cd_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
     OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
     OR (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
),
ca_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
    AND ca_state IN ('NC','TX','IA','WI','WV','GA','OK','VA','KY')
),
r_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r_reason_sk, r_reason_desc, substr(r_reason_desc,1,20) AS r_reason_short
  FROM reason
),
joined AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_quantity,
    wr.wr_refunded_cash,
    wr.wr_fee,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    r.r_reason_short,
    cd1.cd_marital_status,
    cd1.cd_education_status,
    ws.ws_sales_price,
    ca.ca_state,
    ws.ws_net_profit
  FROM ws_filtered ws
  JOIN wr_filtered wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
  JOIN wp_filtered wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  JOIN d_filtered d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN cd_filtered cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
  JOIN cd_filtered cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
  JOIN ca_filtered ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
  JOIN r_filtered r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
  WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT ws_quantity, wr_refunded_cash, wr_fee, r_reason_desc, r_reason_short
  FROM joined
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
    AND (
          (ca_state IN ('NC','TX','IA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
       OR (ca_state IN ('WI','WV','GA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
       OR (ca_state IN ('OK','VA','KY') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
        )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ws_quantity, wr_refunded_cash, wr_fee, r_reason_desc, r_reason_short
  FROM joined
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
    AND (
          (ca_state IN ('NC','TX','IA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
       OR (ca_state IN ('WI','WV','GA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
       OR (ca_state IN ('OK','VA','KY') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
        )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ws_quantity, wr_refunded_cash, wr_fee, r_reason_desc, r_reason_short
  FROM joined
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
    AND (
          (ca_state IN ('NC','TX','IA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
       OR (ca_state IN ('WI','WV','GA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
       OR (ca_state IN ('OK','VA','KY') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
        )
)
SELECT r_reason_short AS substr, avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
FROM filtered
GROUP BY r_reason_desc, r_reason_short
ORDER BY r_reason_short, avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
